TC-09/S17.title: Same-day re-scan of the same supervisor list: nothing is created twice
TC-09/S17.detail: Local, rst-tc09-scans.spec.ts: the real Nursing Home scan sheet with ai/vision:scanCensusSheet answered at the Convex socket with the exact rows the case's photo lists (the photo is a neutral fixture image; the read itself — Vertex / B01 — is not exercised); fresh physician per case, names 'QA TC-09-Sxx <word>' as the matrix asks. Open questions recorded, never judged (brief 2026-10-16): Q1 (the scan replaces today's list), Q6 (a row with no MRN is stored with a generated 'SNF-######' MRN), Q8 (a known name with another MRN), Q2 (count wording). T2 / U9 (Vertex Gemini read the photo; model and AI time logged) cannot be checked locally: the read never reaches the server; the 10-15 dev photo10 run logged them (gemini-3.6-flash, providerMs) but every live read returns no rows (B01, still on 25acd727: convex/ai/vision.ts + convex/lib/modelJson.ts parseModelJson unchanged, no fence stripping, Vertex has no JSON mode). S17: 8/8 judged pass — first scan of the 4 rows (every row prints an MRN) confirmed; the re-scan's sheet says '4 residents found' and '4 already in All Residents · 0 new · 0 to review'; after confirming, each of the four is on Today's Visits once and in All Residents once (backend each exactly once), Alder still keeps Oak 1A and its MRN after two scans.
